issue.title: x= past record trips PomodoroBlockTracker's rewritten-headline debug assert and reports the pre-rename name when plan.default_type renames the entry

task_type_fields.impact: Debug builds (every `cargo test` CLI run and agent smoke runs) exit 101 on an ordinary `x=name` record whenever the selected placeholder links only untyped tasks and `plan.default_type` differs from its name. In release builds the block preview is silently forced to "unchanged". Both builds tell the user they recorded READ when the ledger now says CHORE.
task_type_fields.location: src/native/capture/pomodoro_blocks.rs:864 (rewritten-headline guard) via src/native/capture/pomodoro_past.rs record + open-name agreement
task_type_fields.repro:
Found by the bob-cli-hj land agent on master 7825a98f (debug build) while checking the epic's open-case examples against Bryan's real config. It reproduces with this two-key config:

```sh
D=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $D/vault/2026
printf 'plan:
  default_type: CHORE
types:
  CHORE: magenta
  READ: green
' > $D/config.yml
printf '## Tasks

- [ ] #task First [created::2026-11-01] ^t1
- [ ] #task Second [created::2026-11-01] ^t2
' > $D/vault/bob.md
printf '## Pomodoros
- [x] (**0730-0800** [t:: 30m]) — PLAN
- [x] (**0830-0900** [t:: 30m]) — BUILD
- [ ] () — CHORE
	- [[bob#^t1]]
- [ ] () — READ
	- [[bob#^t2]]
' > $D/vault/2026/20261104.md
BOB_CONFIG_FILE=$D/config.yml BOB_DIR=$D/unused BOB_NOW='2026-11-04 09:13:00' BOB_DAY_FILE=$D/vault/2026/20261104.md \
  target/debug/bob capture -b $D/vault -- 'x=read2'
# thread 'main' panicked at src/native/capture/pomodoro_blocks.rs:864:21: rewritten pomodoro headline has no ref
```

The debug panic also hits `x=read4~`, `x=read2~2 x=fix`, and `x=email1 x=read2~2+`, so pinned and unpinned past records both trip it. With a close part (`x=read2=!1`, `x=read2~=!1`) there is no panic, but the output says `recorded READ 0905-0915 · from READ` while the ledger row is written as `- [x] (**0905-0915** [t:: 10m]) — CHORE`. The READ placeholder's only Task Link is the untyped `^t2`, whose effective type is CHORE through `plan.default_type`, so the open-name agreement renames the recorded entry. Without the config (`BOB_CONFIG_FILE` missing) every command records READ correctly and does not panic.

Likely cause: the past record's name-agreement retitle rewrites the recorded entry's headline after (or as) it moves for chronological filing. `PomodoroBlockTracker` then finds a rewritten headline with no block ref and hits the `debug_assert!(false, "rewritten pomodoro headline has no ref")` arm. Two things to fix: the tracker needs a ref for this rewrite, and the summary/JSON `name` must report the name the row was actually written with, or the rename must not happen when the user selected the entry by name. Which one is right depends on decisions:open-pomodoro-names-follow-task-links. Add a CLI test with a config that sets `plan.default_type`.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-hj landing review hit a debug-build panic in an x= past record under Bryan's real config, and the record reports a different name from the one it writes. The unpinned path does the same, so the segment-suffix epic did not cause it.
